en: A simple machine like a ramp reduces the force needed to lift an object but increases the distance over which you push, keeping total work unchanged.
Friction between your rubber shoes and the ground pushes you forward when you walk instead of only slowing objects down.
Without air resistance, a heavy bowling ball and a light feather dropped from the same height fall at exactly the same speed.
A magnet will not pick up an aluminum can because aluminum is not ferromagnetic like iron, nickel, or cobalt.
Electrons in a closed circuit flow in a complete loop back to the battery and are never used up by a light bulb.
Sunlight reaches Earth by traveling through the vacuum of outer space, proving that light does not need air or any material to travel.
An astronaut floating in outer space cannot hear a nearby explosion because sound waves require a medium like air, water, or solid to travel.
Heat always flows from a warmer object like hot soup into cooler surrounding air, never from cold to hot on its own.
When a battery-powered toy car moves, chemical energy transforms into electrical energy then kinetic energy, but the total amount of energy stays the same.
If you cut a bar magnet in half, each new piece will still have both a north pole and a south pole.
Sound travels about four times faster in water than in air because water molecules are packed closer together and transmit vibrations more quickly.
A book resting on a high shelf has gravitational potential energy stored because of its position above the ground, even though it is not moving.
